HOW TO INSTALL
[/b]
1. Install Smapi: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. Install Content Patcher: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
3. Download this mod.
4. Unzip mod into Stardew Valley Mods folder in your files.
(If you're new at installing mods I recommend watching a youtube tutorial on it)
